title: The time he went blind from tainted whiskey
summary: He once lost his sight for two or three months after drinking whiskey he believes was doctored by a jealous woman.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Well how do you mean, blind? As opposed --
No, I couldn't. They had to lead me across the street. I got hold of some bad whiskey.
Well I've been blind many times since then, too.
But it was supposed to be some very, very good whiskey, but just was a -- I think -- I was told by

someone that somebody had put something in this whiskey, that helped me to not be able to see, try to is probably killed my eyesight. I'm lucky they didn't kill me. One of those things. And I finally came out of it, and --
Who would be that mad at you that they'd do something like that?

Yeah, you know, a little jealousy here and there, I mean -- was that voodoo stuff, which I never believed in. I could -- I didn't want to believe it. They said well, you're blind, and I'm not. One of those things.
I said aw, it can't be voodoo. Who would do a thing like that? But I -- I don't know. I guess they did. Maybe they did, and maybe not. I don't know.
